archetypes.name: Port City
archetypes.strategy_hint: Starts allied and influence-rich. Lean on diplomacy: treaties and foreign transitions are your cheapest tons.

archetypes.name: Industrial City
archetypes.tagline: The furnace that must reinvent itself.
archetypes.strategy_hint: Rich but filthy: industry emits half again as much. Spend the surplus fast or the clock buries you.

archetypes.name: Political Capital
archetypes.tagline: Poor in funds, rich in leverage.
archetypes.strategy_hint: Income runs 25% short, but influence flows. Convert leverage into allies, treaties and other people's money.
